Nadia, the answer is 280 seats, and I've replied in the #strategic-pod thread.

Gideon first posted 300 on Jul 1, then corrected it in the same thread. The 300 included sandbox logins from the May rollout, and 280 was the active production roster as of Jul 1. Ruth acknowledged the 280.

That figure is from July, so the count may have changed since.
